import narwhals as nw

def top_sales(df):
    nw_df = nw.from_native(df)
    result = nw_df.filter(nw.col("amount") > 100).sort("amount", descending=True)
    return nw.to_native(result)


# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import pandas as pd
    import polars as pl
    
    # Test with pandas
    df_pd = pd.DataFrame({
        "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"],
        "amount": [50, 150, 200, 75, 120]
    })
    print("Pandas input:")
    print(df_pd)
    print("\nPandas output:")
    print(top_sales(df_pd))
    print(f"Type: {type(top_sales(df_pd))}\n")
    
    # Test with polars
    df_pl = pl.DataFrame({
        "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"],
        "amount": [50, 150, 200, 75, 120]
    })
    print("Polars input:")
    print(df_pl)
    print("\nPolars output:")
    print(top_sales(df_pl))
    print(f"Type: {type(top_sales(df_pl))}")
